status: KILL (as constructed) / DATA GAP (for true 5Y test)
verdict: [DATA] Two independent problems, not one: (1) the price-percentile proxy itself shows no IC in the two horizons we CAN test (1M, 1Y) - sign flips between windows, magnitude near zero. (2) A genuine 5Y-horizon empirical test is only possible for SP500/NASDAQ/COPPER (long global history); NONE of the India-specific ETFs (gold/silver/factor sleeves) have enough history on disk to produce even one completed 5Y-forward observation. The '5Y' column of the scored snapshot table is therefore a RULE-BASED [INFERENCE] score only, not empirically validated for 8 of 10 assets - do not present it as tested. Needs either (a) a proper PE/CAPE or earnings-yield data source per asset class before the valuation leg is worth re-testing, or (b) several more years of India ETF history to even attempt the 5Y forward-return test honestly.
review_date: 2027-07-17 (earliest realistic re-test point for the India-ETF 5Y-forward gap)
